decisionLogic: sweep mapped transitions in station order from route start to route end
require the after-unit of each transition to equal the before-unit of the next transition
retain repeated occurrences of one finite unit as separate components
ignore classified non-geologic boundaries without splitting a unit interval
uncertainty: Horizontal position remains limited by the source map scale even when vector intersections are numerically exact.
validationMethod: positive, negative, boundary, conflicting-chain, missing-data and out-of-scope tests
reopenCondition: Overlapping polygons, fault offsets, exact map-position uncertainty envelopes or closed-loop routes are introduced.
